Featured Match

The leader and the side with the most big weeks

Home
benditlikebergvall
7–2 · 848 pts
vs
Away
bjennings28
4–5 · 782 pts

bjennings28 has posted the biggest score of the gameweek three times this season. Nobody else has done it more than once, and he is 4-5. The other six weeks explain it: three of them landed in the bottom four, and he has faced the second-hardest run of opponents in the league. Trafford and Bruno Fernandes have carried the good weeks. benditlikebergvall is 7-2, top on points, and the model's favourite at better than two in five. He won again this week with Haaland contributing almost nothing and his defenders covering for him. These two have met eight times across two seasons and the leader has won five. The question is which version of bjennings28 turns up.

Featured Match

Two 5-4 sides that are better than that

Home
skoeiboy
5–4 · 811 pts
vs
Away
mdropkin
5–4 · 789 pts

Both of these managers are 5-4, and both have a record their scoring does not deserve. skoeiboy is third on points and won this week with Palmer, his best forward of the gameweek by a distance, sitting on the bench. mdropkin has the second-best all-play record in the league and is 5-4 because two of his nine weeks were his two worst, one of them the lowest score anyone but the winless side has posted all season. Rice and João Pedro have done most of his scoring. The model prefers skoeiboy on title chance, roughly one in fifteen to one in twenty-five, but there is not much between the rosters. A win here keeps one of them within sight of the leaders, with the points to back it up.
